extracted.name: Easy Faux Chocolate Mousse
extracted.description: This mascarpone chocolate “mousse” may play tricks on your eyes and your tastebuds since it tastes like authentic mousse — but it’s made with no eggs!
instruction_lines: Mix mascarpone cheese, whipping cream, and vanilla together in a bowl.
Melt chocolate chips in the top of a double boiler over simmering water, stirring frequently and scraping down the sides with a rubber spatula to avoid scorching.
Fold melted chocolate into mascarpone cheese mixture. Refrigerate until set, 1 to 2 hours.
